facts.fact: The 2026 finance law appropriates FCFA 45,991,319,076 for programme 22126 Economie numérique et poste of the Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalisation (section 356), funded from domestic revenue.
facts.system: Programme 22126 Economie numérique et poste, FY2026

facts.fact: Programme 22126 rises from FCFA 19,033,679,859 in the 2025 budget to FCFA 45,991,319,076 in the 2026 budget, up 141.6%.
